svg.title: Share of requests solved, by stated cause and true fault, per model
svg.desc: One grid per model and setting. Rows: the cause the error message states; columns: the true fault. Red outlines mark the two traps. Data in stated_true_grid.csv.
svg.text: The stated cause steers every model, and most fall into both traps
Share of requests solved, by the cause the error states (rows) and the true fault (columns).
Red outline: the two traps. C4 grid, 30 runs of 6 requests per cell.
Columns: the true fault. Cell values: % of requests solved.
